services.name: Sunset Cruises
services.desc: Sailboats differ from other types of boats in that they are capable of being propelled entirely by wind; they use sails to transform the wind energy into propulsion that moves a boat through the water. Sailors are passionate about their sport. There is a sense of empowerment as the wind fills the sails and the boat glides peacefully through the water. Sailing is a green activity and is fulfilling for anyone at any age. Sailing can be shared with family and friends, close to home or in beautiful cruising grounds worldwide. Whether you’re interested in day sailing, cruising, competitive racing, or charter vacations, our two or three hour Discover Sailing charter is a great way to get started.

blurb: Guests can learn sailing through interactive online theory combined with hands-on practical training on Lake Travis. Corporate outings offer team-building experiences on modern coastal cruising sailboats with options for meals and activities. Courses range from basic crew skills to advanced bareboat charter master training.
